Class Component

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.componentClasses.Component
Direct Known Subclasses:
Cabin, ConfigurableComponent, Empty, LifeSupport, Shield, Space, Structural
public class Component extends Object
This class represents a generic component used to assemble the players' ships. This class describes a generic component used to assemble the players' ships. Each subclass of "Component" represents instead a specific type of component
